records.name: product.label.layout.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <form>
                <group>
                    <group>
                        <field name="product_ids" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="product_tmpl_ids" invisible="1"/>
                        <field name="custom_quantity"/>
                        <field name="print_format" widget="radio"/>
                    </group>
                    <group>
                        <field name="pricelist_id" groups="product.group_product_pricelist"/>
                        <field name="extra_html" invisible="print_format != '2x7xprice'"/>
                    </group>
                </group>
                <footer>
                    <button name="process" string="Print" type="object" class="btn-primary"/>
                    <button string="Discard" class="btn-secondary" special="cancel"/>
                </footer>
            </form>
        </field>

records.name: product.label.layout.form
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name="custom_quantity"]" position="before">
                <field name="move_quantity"/>
            </xpath>
            <xpath expr="//field[@name='custom_quantity']" position="attributes">
                <attribute name="invisible">move_quantity == 'move'</attribute>
            </xpath>
        </field>

records.name: product.label.layout.form.stock
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <xpath expr="//field[@name="pricelist_id"]" position="after">
                <field name="zpl_template" invisible="'zpl' not in print_format"/>
                <field name="zpl_preview" invisible="'zpl' not in print_format" widget="image" options="{'img_class': 'border'}" nolabel="1"/>
            </xpath>
        </field>
